visuals.name: ControlsExplainer
visuals.defaultValue:
## Filter Visuals

This page demonstrates **every filter and input control** type available in Report-SQL.

| Control | Type | Binds to |
|---------|------|----------|
| Category Filter | `SLICER` | `@category` |
| Region Filter | `MULTISELECT` | `@region` |
| Start Date | `DATEPICKER` | `@startDate` |
| End Date | `DATEPICKER` | `@endDate` |
| Min Quantity | `SLIDER` | `@minQty` |
| Keyword | `SEARCH` | `@search` |

Changes to any control above propagate instantly to all dependent visuals (without a full page reload).

> **Tip:** The `SLICER`, `SEARCH`, and `DATEPICKER` use `SET_PARAMETER` actions.
> The `SLIDER` uses a `MINMAX`-compatible binding.

visuals.name: ButtonsText
visuals.defaultValue:
### Buttons
`CREATE BUTTON` defines interactive **BACK**, **REFRESH**, and custom action buttons.

| Name | Type | Purpose |
|------|------|---------|
| BtnRefresh | `REFRESH` | Force rebuild of all visual snapshots |
| BtnBack | `BACK` | Navigate to previous browser page |
| BtnExport | `REFRESH` | Custom export trigger (custom types pending engine support) |

> Buttons cannot currently be placed directly in page `MAP` slots — they require a dedicated button bar component (tracked in TODO.md).
